title: The Noise I Make When I Sit Down
style: 1920s australian vaudeville banjo, 140 BPM, plucked banjo lead, kazoo, washboard percussion, ukulele strum, jaunty upright bass, two male vocals trading lines with broad aussie accents, comedic body-betrayal duet, music hall energy, knee-pop SFX, happy bouncing tempo
lyrics:
[Intro — banjo flourish, kazoo trill, washboard scrape]
Oof! Aaah! Crikey!
Just sat down on the couch, mate

[Verse 1 — both, alternating, broad aussie accents]
[mate] I used to sit down quietly, you'd never even know
[partner] You'd hear the cushion exhale and that's how the breath would go
[mate] Now I sit down on the lounge and the whole street hears me groan
[partner] Sounds like a possum landing on a corrugated zone

[Pre-Chorus — both]
Ooof when I sit
Aaah when I rise
Ouch when I bend
A whole opera with these knees and thighs

[Chorus — both, banjo cranked]
The noise I make when I sit down!
The noise I make when I sit down!
Forty-five years on this earth so kind
And I sound like an old door creakin' behind!
The noise I make when I sit down!

[Verse 2]
[mate] I bent over to tie up me shoelace this morning
[partner] You let out a sound like a possum performing
[mate] I reached for the toaster on the top of the shelf
[partner] You creaked like a haunted house all by yourself

[Pre-Chorus]
The chair makes a sigh when I lower me bones
The bed lets a creak when I climb in alone
Me knees pop a rhythm, me back makes a song
Every joint in the body singing all day long

[Chorus — both, full banjo and washboard]
The noise I make when I sit down!
The noise I make when I sit down!
Forty-five years on this earth so kind
And I sound like an old door creakin' behind!
The noise I make when I sit down!

[Bridge — banjo solo, then spoken]
[mate] Crikey, when did this start happening?
[partner] About the time you turned forty.
[mate] What's it gonna be like at sixty?
[partner] You'll need a brass band just to roll over.
[mate] …CRIKEY.

[Outro — banjo wind down, kazoo huff]
The noise I make when I sit down!
We are a percussion section all on our own!
The noise I make when I sit down!
[banjo flourish, knee crack SFX, kazoo whoop]
